scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background

Unlabelled demonstration animals occupy corresponding background locations, including the upper-left animal at 1 cm/px, bright upper-edge animals at 2–4 cm/px and lower/right-edge animals.

Background shading/detail differs between rows, particularly the upper-left animal at 1 cm/px and lower animals at 3–4 cm/px. Its cause is not established; bitwise/photometric background equivalence and a USD state mutation are not inferred.
This engineering presentation review does not certify visibility, biological pose, water optics or exact visible/refracted outlines; machine visibility remains unknown.
